name: fm-index-pilot-twenty
purpose: Paired CONTROL vs CONTROL+formula_index pilot on Financial_Model. Tests whether a deterministic relative-formula index increases structurally correct formula completion where the correct computation already exists in the input. Not a LibreCalc experiment.
sampling: Deterministic, predeclared, never historical scores. Negative controls: even-space of 3 from the 11 Gate-2 zero-recoverable FM tasks. Mechanism-positive: 2 even-spaced from the 10 fewest-family books, 2 from the 10 most-formula books, 3 from tasks with same-row non-adjacent homologues, 3 with same-column non-adjacent, 3 with cross-sheet, then even-space fill to 17.

arms.control: --control, official config, 50 calls, $2, reasoning low, remaining-budget
